# convoy_endpoint_secret_rotation (Action)

Rotates an endpoint's signing secret: the current secret is expired after `expiration` and a new one (supplied or generated by Convoy) becomes active. Run `terraform apply -refresh-only` afterwards to pick the new secret up in a `convoy_endpoint` that does not set `secret` explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# terraform apply -invoke=action.convoy_endpoint_secret_rotation.acme
action "convoy_endpoint_secret_rotation" "acme" {
  config {
    endpoint_id = convoy_endpoint.acme.id
    expiration  = 3600
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (String) Endpoint whose secret is rotated.

### Optional

- `expiration` (Number) Grace period during which the previous secret remains valid. Defaults to `0`.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `secret` (String) New secret. Generated by Convoy when omitted. Action arguments are not persisted to state; pass an ephemeral or sensitive value.
